answer: A workable design: lock a compute bond for six epochs and slash it the moment two answers fingerprint-match. Clustering on shared timing signatures exposes the operator. Because it works by converting a one-time spend into a recurring per-account bill, payouts to the cluster are redistributed to the honest peer pool. The network ties the mesa to sunk effort, uses the wander as an corroborating signal, then requires a nectar before any payout.
